test_cases.description: Verify ease of navigation through the LLM app interface
preconditions: User has access to the LLM app
User is on the home screen
steps: Navigate to different sections: Dashboard, Queries, Settings, Support
Attempt to return to the home screen from each section
expected_results: User can easily navigate to all sections
Navigational buttons and menus are clearly labeled and intuitive
User can return to the home screen without any confusion

test_cases.description: Verify the user-interaction flow when submitting a query
preconditions: User has access to the LLM app
User is on the query submission page
steps: Enter a query into the input field
Observe the response and how it is presented
Test error handling by submitting an incomplete query
expected_results: Query input field accepts text and 'Submit' button is clearly visible
Response is provided in a clear and understandable format
Error messages are informative and guide the user to correct their input
